scope: Current-main repair search for a failed historical route in two bundled Amiga archives, with a related DOS source that shares its initial hash.

auditFailurePool.identityNote: Ten of the 18 failed-hash groups also occur on a winning row. Six of those groups include a winning row with a different title. A shared initial hash does not identify a bundled level or transfer a route.

target.title: Don’t do anything too hasty

historicalCandidate.currentAuditResult: The exact build 83 audit rejected the candidate outcome in both archive copies. It recorded expected 80 saved, got 0.

target.fingerprintLimit: ClassicDOSReplayRecorder.stateHash hashes the remaining time, counters, remaining skills, lemming state, selected configuration values, and solid/steel terrain bytes. It omits terrain dimensions, entrance and trigger definitions, destruction masks, hatch source offsets, and some continuation state such as release countdowns, trigger cooldowns, queued commands and the nuke cursor. Matching hashes therefore do not prove full simulation equivalence. The audit accepts the witness for the DOS source and rejects it for both Amiga sources; compare omitted inputs and replay semantics before transferring a route between identities.

provenance.resourceNote: The targeted archive hashes match current-main audit source revisions. This is not a complete build 86 package audit.

interpretation: Neither Amiga archive copy has a verified winning route. The same incomplete initial simulation hash occurs for a related DOS source where the candidate passes. Do not transfer that route across source identities until the omitted initial inputs are covered. The bounded Amiga searches do not prove either level impossible.
